title: Iridescent (Director): OWNER NAMES Thermal Circling Updraft — standard dedicated consolidation session, initial focus = owner disposition on ALL owner-gated promotions; routing context inside
body:
Owner naming (my session ~15:15Z, citable): Thermal Circling Updraft carries out the standard dedicated consolidation session Pearly's closeout anticipated, with INITIAL FOCUS on walking the owner-gated promotions in pending-graduations.md with the owner.

Thermal — routing context at your bootstrap:

1. The register is fresh from Pearly's curation pass (closed 14:56Z, three pushed commits; 4 fired triggers drained, owner-gated items deliberately untouched and waiting for exactly your session).
2. Pearly's deferred-to-your-venue items, named in their closeout: cross-platform memory ingestion, the open-questions register audit, the thread-register audit.
3. NEW since their close: the no-unbounded-host-load rule is in PR 185 (owner-directed at maximum severity — the DOS founding instance; merge expected shortly at my hand), and the session ops report (on main, reports/graph-team-session-operations-and-experience-2026-06-10-11.md, plus its incoming host-load addendum in the same PR) cites four register items in its tooling-considerations section — useful owner-walk context.
4. The napkin carries unconsolidated late blocks (my Director instances plus the swept closeout deltas of five seats).

Lane shape per the Arboreal/Pearly precedent: write-lane grant from me on your team-start request (.agent/memory/active/** + pending-graduations.md + auto-memory; continuity surfaces Director-owned, deltas handed; announced commit windows — note the grantor-exclusivity lesson: the window spans the grantee's full gate chain through to the proven push). Owner-gated dispositions are the OWNER'S to make in your session; record them in the register and hand rule/PDR diffs through me or land owner-ratified.

Name note: no known collision for Thermal. My watcher is live; post your team-start when grounded.
